head: 98a2f1d
summary: Delivered independent .NET 10 packaging, four linux/amd64 source images, guarded azd/Terraform, consumer configuration, optional safe telemetry, dormant CI and Python operations handoff. Build/format and 1,551 fast tests passed; mocked Terraform and actionlint passed. Final artifact revision is 2e8ba28. API policy remains blocked; gateway threshold passed with 19 failures. No live deployment, push or product changes. Worker App Service and external orchestrator ingress remain unavailable; native schema/grants, readiness, privacy and owner decisions are explicit.

deviations.what: The preparation plan is recorded in the owned running log, not a root .azure plan.
deviations.why: The explicit task ownership boundary prohibits creating root preparation assets; no cloud deployment lifecycle was invoked.

deviations.what: Native build-platform SDK cross-publishes linux-x64 images.
deviations.why: The available Linux engine is arm64; emulated amd64 SDK execution exited 139. All final runtime images are verified linux/amd64 and nonroot.

deviations.what: The measured Docker build uses an explicitly selected bounded offline feed of 113 exact public package archives.
deviations.why: Container NuGet HTTPS failed NU1301/OpenSSL handshake. Archive checks plus fresh locked restore succeeded without TLS bypass; online vulnerability-feed audit is not claimed.

deviations.what: Orchestrator proof requires a kernel-isolated network namespace, not a purported loopback URL override.
deviations.why: The installed Responses SDK binds AnyIP 8088 despite --urls/ASPNETCORE_URLS. Default and nonisolated launches exit 78; external ingress remains disabled.

deviations.what: Worker has a portable image but its App Service topology is explicitly refused.
deviations.why: The Generic Host exposes no HTTP lifecycle/progress health seam. A dummy web sidecar would falsely report a dead poller as healthy.

findings: API readiness returns HTTP 200 with ready=false; gateway readiness is constant HTTP 200/true even with an unavailable source. Status-only probes do not establish dependency health.

API replay: 1,514 exchanges and 2,311 raw differing fields; framework waivers 9/17=52.94% exceed the unchanged 25% cap. Gateway: 255 exchanges, 523 raw fields, 236 passed/19 failed, 11 waived, 92.55% threshold pass is not parity.

Worker invalid deployed configuration refusal was observed under qemu, but uncaught target signal 6 was not reaped. Abnormal exit remains unverified; daemon SIGTERM 143 is not graceful-drain proof. Ordinary finite Worker and two existing accepted-work/publication tests passed.

Both public synthetic payroll CSVs, embedded prompt .resx and embedded source mapping are genuinely consumed build/runtime inputs. Private extract, environment files, databases and contract seeds are excluded.
SOURCE_SCHEMA absent means tcc_source; empty means dbo. SOURCE_MAPPING_FILE and Python lease/concurrency settings do not control ordinary .NET composition.

Gateway composes application services in-process and needs source/Gold/ops/Blob privileges. Existing Python gateway SQL profile is audit-only; lakehouse grant tool refuses the configured gateway principal and must not be bypassed.
The five native schema additions are absent from current authored migrations. The unchanged Python migration runner can execute an approved forward migration but cannot supply missing DDL.

Actual API/gateway each exported two server spans and one metric series through the optional Hook; actual dependency correlation is absent. Two dependency-parent edges and exit-flush timings are controlled synthetic probe evidence.

Configured infrastructure diagnostics export AllMetrics only, with HTTP/console categories excluded and host log levels None. Direct orchestrator console logging and inherited gateway privacy boundaries are not thereby fixed.

Full azd environment/package orchestration, OIDC/private SCM promotion and native Fabric/Blob/Entra/Foundry behavior were not executed. The owned MSBuild packaging primitive and official manifest schema were validated.
M-01 ingestion precedence, first-program multi-program pricing, zero-worksite SQL/projector, leap-window context and native money/AVG remain unchanged figure-sensitive owner decisions.

The count/max-modified source marker is not a transactional Delta snapshot. The 600-second lease lacks periodic renewal; restart loses host-local tickets/confirmations and there is no gateway unknown-result recovery endpoint.
No new replay waiver or application dependency was added. Existing inherited HALT-integrate-W3.md remains; no literal HALT.md or session hard-stop file was created.
open_questions: Approved non-HTTP Worker hosting/supervision or an application-owned lifecycle-coupled progress/health seam remains unselected.
The verified upstream subject/employer-binding ingress and future durable recovery/multi-replica design require owner selection before external orchestrator activation.
Native migration/backfill handling of historical equal-timestamp override intent requires review; the original order cannot be recovered.
The owner must resolve the inherited figure-sensitive and privacy/parity findings before cutover, without reclassifying changed figures as improvements.

needs_human.item: Author and approve the five native forward schema additions and service-specific grants using the existing Python operator path.
needs_human.why: Required DDL is not authored/applied; Fabric NOT ENFORCED uniqueness is not proof. Pause all writers, review historical ordering and verify independent native transactions, fencing, publication, pooling and numeric scale.

needs_human.item: Supply real Worker supervision and native amd64 abnormal-exit/drain proof.
needs_human.why: App Service expects HTTP startup health; this Generic Host has none, and emulation did not reliably reap the configuration abort. The topology stays unavailable.

needs_human.item: Implement verified person/client ingress and direct-origin isolation before enabling orchestrator.
needs_human.why: Mapped headers and opaque user keys are not authenticated identity or employer authorization; URL configuration does not constrain the SDK listener.

needs_human.item: Close dependency-readiness, privacy, parity and figure-sensitive application decisions.
needs_human.why: API semantic policy is still blocked, gateway has 19 failures, readiness routes are insufficient and safe telemetry does not sanitize direct console paths or resolve calculation boundaries.

needs_human.item: Approve native environment, private OIDC publisher, schema/grants and artifact promotion, then verify served revision and native behavior.
needs_human.why: No live deployment or automatic provisioning was authorized. The .NET backend/targets must remain independent; online package audit, existing full heavy gate and consumer-side private SCM/image checks remain release work.
